cold: ScikitFemBackend.solve_many of the request: the unchanged S10 load-stepped solve; one run per case, timed
corrected: piginot.serving.serve(mode='certified', corrected=True): the one-step corrected displacement at the FEM nodes
equivalence: per case: max |u_exact - u_cold| / max |u_cold| over the FEM nodes; |Pi_exact - Pi_cold| / |Pi_cold|; relative L2 difference of the first Piola stress at the quadrature points
evidence_role: DEVELOPMENT (opened in S14); HOLDOUT and fresh H1/H2 are not touched
exact: piginot.serving.serve(mode='exact') end to end (prediction, displacement at the FEM nodes, certificate, solve ladder), excluding bundle loading; one run per case, timed
peak_stress: the largest Frobenius norm of the recovered (L2-projected) first Piola stress over the FEM nodes, computed the same way for the cold solution, the operator's displacement and the corrected displacement; peak error = |peak - cold peak| / cold peak. The served-stress peak error of the operator is reported beside it
requests: each case's FEM request is rebuilt from its inputs by the bundle's recipe (byte-identical to the S10 request, artifacts/serving/S22-RECIPES.json)

thresholds.determinism: an exact result hash and a certified document re-served under the protocol's conditions equal the recorded ones
thresholds.fast_unchanged: serve(mode='fast') documents of the example requests equal the S19 golden digests of this execution profile
thresholds.never_silent: every exact request converges (any ladder path) or returns an explicit solve_failed
thresholds.old_bundles: the gated v0.1.0 bundles load unchanged and their recipes bind their manifests (tests/test_shipped_bundles.py, tests/serving/test_recipe.py)

thresholds_accepted: decision owner, 2026-10-11 (chat: 'start implementation' after the seven S22 thresholds were explained, including the 10x speed-up)
timing: worker processes with one torch thread; per-case speed-up = cold time / exact time
trial_before_protocol: one case per family (notched candidate-000020, DogBone candidate-000156) was served in all modes in the cloud workspace while building S22: exact 3.5-3.9 s via warm Newton (4 iterations) against about 115 s cold; both are part of the population and are re-run on the reference machine
